item.title: Galgotias University Asked To Vacate AI Summit Expo Immediately: Sources
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 18: Galgotias University has been asked to vacate its stall at the AI Summit Expo immediately, sources said, amid a controversy over the display of a robotic dog that raised questions about the origin and ownership of the technology showcased. item.description: LONDON, Feb 18: Fallout from the Jeffrey Epstein files has landed on the gilded wood and plush red benches of Britain’s House of Lords.
